nodes.summary: For a permutation $w$ of $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$, read as the word $w(0)\,w(1) \cdots w(n-1)$, the number of descents $d(w)$ is the number of indices $i$ with $i + 1 < n$ and $w(i) > w(i+1)$.
nodes.title: Number of descents of a permutation of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$

nodes.summary: There exist $n$ and a naturally labeled relation $R$ on the labels $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$, one in which $R(i, j)$ implies $i < j$, such that the $W$-polynomial $W(P, x)$ of the poset $P$ generated by $R$ has a complex zero that is not real.
nodes.title: Neggers' conjecture is false

nodes.summary: For every $n$ and every relation $R$ on the labels $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$ that is naturally labeled, meaning that $R(i, j)$ implies $i < j$, every complex zero of the $W$-polynomial $W(P, x)$ of the poset $P$ generated by $R$ is real.
nodes.title: Neggers' conjecture

nodes.summary: Let $R$ be a relation on the labels $\{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$, with $R(i, j)$ read as $i \lt _P j$ in the poset $P$ it generates. A linear extension of $P$ is a permutation $w$ of the labels such that $a < b$ whenever $R(w(a), w(b))$, that is, a word $w(0)\,w(1) \cdots w(n-1)$ listing every label once with $w(a)$ before $w(b)$ whenever $R(w(a), w(b))$. The $W$-polynomial is the integer polynomial…
nodes.title: The $W$-polynomial of a labeled poset

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
